How it works story: asset prompts for GPT Image

The story is built from separate pieces that the code positions and animates. Generate every item as its own PNG. Don't make full scenes, because I can't move parts of a flattened picture.

Every prompt below is complete: the style prefix is already written in, so copy the whole block. Under each prompt, Attach shows the reference images to upload with it. They're all in docs/hiw-story-refs/. Keep generating in one GPT chat so the style stays locked.

LookUsed forHow it looks
Line artBuildings, walls, trees, skyline, hills: everything behind the peopleNavy ink lines, flat cream fill inside shapes, no colour, no shading. I recolour it to soft grey and thin the lines afterwards, so keep generating in navy.
Character stylePeople, props they touch, plants in frontThe style of the Rekha and Arjun sheets: flat warm colours, soft grain, chunky friendly shapes

Scale guide: Rekha standing is 1R tall. Arjun standing is 1A, drawn about 1.8× taller on screen. Sizes are approximate (I scale in code), but proportions matter.

1. Rules for every image (removal and clean-up)

Check each PNG against this list before sending it:

  1. Real transparency. No white box, no halo, and no fake grey checkerboard baked into the pixels. The shop and both machines came back with one, especially on EDITs.
  2. No ground or floor under the object. I draw the ground in code.
  3. No shadows of any kind. I add these in code.
  4. No people in prop or background images.
  5. No text, except where a prompt asks for a sign. No watermarks.
  6. Straight side view at eye level, with a flat horizontal bottom edge so it sits on my ground line.
  7. Crop tight, with about 2% padding. At least 1536 px on the longest side.
  8. Several items on one sheet: leave clear empty space between them, so I can split them automatically.
  9. Line art only: fill closed shapes with solid cream (not transparent), make glass fully transparent, and draw lines in one navy colour at one even weight.
  10. Characters only: same scale as the reference sheet, with feet flat on one line at the bottom, and no furniture, railing or plant in the pose.

4. Delivery checklist

  • Every file is a PNG with real transparency (no white box, no baked-in checkerboard)
  • No ground, floor, shadow or stray text
  • EDITs keep the original's table, machine and canvas exactly where they were
  • Sheets with several items have clear empty space between them
  • Characters match their reference sheet's scale, with feet on one flat line

Paste them here or drop them into public/hiw-story/new/. I'll clean, crop, size and place them.
